metadata.description: Evaluates whether GPD tail index xi carries information beyond MDD for spoken/written register discrimination and typological prediction across 18 UD treebanks. gen_art_experiment_1 crashed and produced no output (see experiment_status), so xi/MDD/typology-join were computed here directly from gen_art_dataset_1's already-collected per-sentence raw dependency distances (deterministic, no LLM calls, no re-fetching).

treebank_level_direction.note: Treebank-level direction summary has only n=4 language pairs (one degree of freedom per language) so it is a descriptive tally, not a powered test; the Wilcoxon signed-rank test below instead pairs on sentence-length deciles within each language to get a usable sample size.

metadata.typology_coverage_note: Grambank typology (case_richness, head_finality_grambank) available for 16/18 treebanks; missing for ['nap_rb', 'pcm_nsc']. head_finality_empirical and word_order_flexibility are computed directly from UD annotations for all 18 treebanks and used as the primary typology signal; case_richness (Grambank-only) is NaN and dropped listwise for the 3 uncovered treebanks in models that include it.

examples.input: {"note": "no treebanks flagged as outliers (|z|<=2 for all)"}
